rules: Never lower or remove a stop
Never re-buy a stock the same day its stop fired
Every line has its stop and take-profit set in the app
Buy a dip only on a signal
At most 2 open lines per theme
$400 a buy, 5 slots, cash never under $150
No buys in the 3 days before earnings or on Fed days
A short study before every buy
